title: Top 3 Scorers
description:
Given:
```python
data = {"alice": 95, "bob": 87, "charlie": 92, "diana": 88, "eve": 91}
```
Print the top 3 scorers in descending order of score, one per line in the format `name:score`.

**Expected output:**
```
alice:95
charlie:92
eve:91
```
starterCode:
data = {"alice": 95, "bob": 87, "charlie": 92, "diana": 88, "eve": 91}
# Print top 3 scorers in descending score order
hint: Sort the dictionary items by value in descending order: sorted(data.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True). Take the first 3.
